bugs_found: transfer() is not atomic: if assignment to account_to.balance fails after account_from.balance has been decremented, funds are lost (no rollback/transaction)
loan_payment with r==0 returns p/m but does not coerce m to Decimal, may return float-tainted division in some contexts
compound_interest uses int(years) silently truncating fractional years instead of raising or supporting them
apply_fee multiplies fmin by Decimal('1.0') unnecessarily (cosmetic, but obscures intent)
no thread-safety on Account mutation in transfer()
fx_convert does not validate that rate is positive (rate==0 or negative would silently produce 0/negative result)
